name: StyleSeat
tagline: StyleSeat is a booking marketplace for hair stylists, colorists, and other beauty professionals that uses AI-driven recommendations to match clients with the right pro nearby. It handles scheduling, reminders, and payments, and gives stylists tools to track rebooking rates and fill gaps in their calendar.
